summary: A README that answers a stranger's questions in order, with the honest part (what is real and what is not) near the top; one Mermaid architecture diagram whose boxes are checked by a script against the services of compose.yaml; and a one-line explanation of every box. Run for real on the capstone repository, including what the check says when a box is misspelt.
goal: Draw the diagram and explain each box in one line.

items.text: Write README.md with the six sections in the order of a stranger's questions
Draw the Mermaid diagram of your system with six boxes at most and a label on every arrow
Misspell one box, then rename a service in compose.yaml, and read what the check says each time
Write one line for each box, and the sections on what is real and on known limits
Play the README Check game to the end and see your score
